name: manual_133410
claim: When a change turns an optional collaborator into a required fail-closed port, every out-of-repository check written before it is stale evidence: rerun each such check from the merged main heads before citing it, and replace a failing one with a dated revision that injects the port instead of editing the original.

decisions.notes: The 2026-10-19 abandon interop script failed at S11 on the merged mains because slice 2 made the consumer abandon authenticator required; the product was right and the script was stale. A pass recorded before the merge said nothing about the merged code.

rationale: The 2026-10-19 abandon interop script failed at S11 on the merged mains because slice 2 made the consumer abandon authenticator required; the product was right and the script was stale. A pass recorded before the merge said nothing about the merged code.
